correctness.rationale: For 3×3 matrices of coefficients in µ_q, q∈{2,3,4,6}, checked the aperiodic difference autocorrelation Parseval identity against coefficient-convolution Parseval. Three independent phase modulations uniquely set c00=c01=c10=1, leaving exactly q^6 choices: 64+729+4096+46656=51545. Independently regenerated energies in Gaussian/Eisenstein integer arithmetic with a separately written convolution loop; found minima 113,97,105,97 and normalized equality counts 8,2,16,6 respectively. Each orbit under the free µ_q^3 action has q^3 members, giving 64,54,1024,1296 ordered minimizers. For ternary arrays the zero shift contributes 81 and sixteen mixed displacements have 1,2,4 Eisenstein-root summands, hence squared norm ≥1; µ_3 Fourier matrix ω^{ij} and conjugate attain 97, complete uniqueness comes from finite exhaustion. These statements are exhaustive ONLY for the four listed finite alphabets and this 3×3 aperture.
